item.title: Eduardo Cantu re-elected to Hidalgo County Commissioner, Precinct 2 seat
item.description: HIDALGO COUNTY, Texas (ValleyCentral) — Residents of Hidalgo County have re-elected Eduardo 'Eddie' Cantu for Hidalgo County Commissioner Precinct 2, unofficial voting results show. Cantu received 9,740 votes against Pablo Soto Jr., who received 4,167 votes, according to unofficial Hidalgo County election results. There were no Republican candidates. item.title: Abbott projected as GOP nominee for governor; set to face Hinojosa in November
item.description: Incumbent Gov. Greg Abbott is set for a run at a fourth term after winning the GOP nomination on Tuesday, according to Associated Press Projections. On the Democratic side, Texas Rep. Gina Hinojosa, D-Austin, is the projected winner.
